Fix: apply the same permission check used at those other entry points so the button only renders when the user has Can Create encounter.
Create a GitHub issue in ohcnetwork/care_fe, assign it to yourself, and open a PR fixing this (small, isolated diff).

input.title: EncounterHistory empty-state "Create Encounter" button is not permission-gated
input.body:
## Problem

In `EncounterHistory.tsx`, the empty-state "Create Encounter" button does not check the `can_create_encounter` permission before it renders.

The other 3 encounter creation entry points check this permission:
- Patient home page
- Appointment "Start Consultation" button
- Appointment "Create Planned Encounter" button

## Expected Behavior

The empty-state "Create Encounter" button in `EncounterHistory.tsx` must render only when the user has the `can_create_encounter` permission, like the other entry points.

## Location

`src/components/Patient/PatientDetailsTab/EncounterHistory.tsx`, near line 82.
